description:
Activate Bristly Bill by paying {3}{G}{G}, doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2 four additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.name: Devoted Druid
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and with five or more +1/+1 counters on it
